### tree

```bash
# 只显示2层
tree -L 2

# 只显示目录
tree -d

# 显示文件大小
tree -sh

tree -pugD
1212
sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/95proxy >/dev/null <<'EOF'
Acquire::http::Proxy "http://127.0.0.1:7897";
Acquire::https::Proxy "http://127.0.0.1:7897";
EOF

```
